title: 5.2 Food and Drinks
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Recognize and name five common foods and three common drinks in familiar sentence frames.
grammar_function: Use familiar be + eating/drinking patterns and It is with new food and drink nouns.
prerequisite: 5.1 Fruits; Unit 1 people and actions; Unit 2 object identity.
speaking_outcome: Name bread, rice, an egg, chicken, water, and juice; fish and milk receive speaking retrieval in 5.3-5.10.

cards.pedagogy_note: New; visual must distinguish from water.
New category word, introduced before 5.5 uses it.
New plural category word; ten Learn cards remain within the 8-14 A1 recommendation.
Review listening-to-text; every distractor changes one meaningful element.
Coach initial and final consonants only after a miss.
Apple is review distractor; both fit article but only image decides.
Review man and action; rice is visibly not a drink.
